notes: Independence: all Dodge/Chrysler/Mopar/Stellantis material (brochures, press kits, fact sheets, history releases) counts as ONE source, and all Wikipedia articles count as ONE. A 'confirmed' or 'three_sources_not_nhra' status means at least three of NHRA / Dodge / EPA / Wikipedia / an independent publication agree.

The Plymouth Barracuda brochures (verify_plymouth-barracuda-1970-1974.json) were not reused because none of them mention the Challenger. The Charger-modern Stellantis citations were not reused either, since each Challenger year has its own Dodge fact sheet.
NHRA's 2009-2021 modern rows are either NHRA factored ratings for street cars (5.7 at 300, 6.1 at 340, 392 at 380/413) or Drag Pak race cars under 'Challenger R'. Advertised figures come from Dodge.

Dealer conversions are not factory engines and get status dealer_conversion; they are not listed per year: SMS 570/570X, Mr. Norm's, SpeedFactory SF600R, Richard Petty Signature Series, Legacy by Petty (Wikipedia - Dodge Challenger (2008)).
Stellantis media pages were read with a scripted fetch of media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/newsrelease.do. allpar, Hemmings, MotorTrend and C&D were not used, and Curbside Classic returned 403.
